title: Intermittent Zero-Copy segment refresh timeouts

architecture.synopsis: CRM Core feeds identity into Data Cloud. A Zero Copy Data Stream reads curated tables in Snowflake. Segment refresh jobs run hourly. A batch Data Transform (BDT) rebuilds a curated DLO used by two high-value segments.
architecture.diagramLabel: Zero Copy, BDT, curated DLO, segments

issue: For two weeks, segment refresh was stable. Now refreshes intermittently fail with query timeout near the top of the hour. Ops already enlarged the Snowflake warehouse once; failures continue.

probes.label: What changed in the curated DLO definition in the last sprint?
probes.answer: Two formula fields were added that expand nested account attributes at query time against the Zero Copy source.

probes.label: Do BDT runs overlap the segment refresh window?
probes.answer: Yes. After a scheduler change, BDT start slipped 12 minutes and now overlaps the hourly segment refresh.

probes.label: Are timeouts correlated with a specific segment?
probes.answer: Both failing segments read the same curated DLO; other segments on different DLOs are fine.

probes.label: What does the Snowflake query profile show during failures?
probes.answer: Long scan plus remote spill while evaluating expressions over the Zero Copy external path.

probes.label: Is the Zero Copy connector hitting documented API rate limits?
probes.answer: No sustained 429s. Connector health looks normal between failures.

probes.label: Did the CRM to Data Cloud identity sync lag increase?
probes.answer: Identity sync lag is unchanged and within SLO; failures are on segment refresh, not identity.

probes.label: Is cross-region network latency elevated?
probes.answer: Cloud monitoring shows no latency incident in the window. Timeouts are query-side.

goldCause.text: Formula fields on the curated DLO force expensive Zero Copy evaluation, and after the BDT schedule slip those scans overlap segment refresh, causing intermittent timeouts.
goldCause.rationale: The failure mode is concurrent heavy evaluation against Zero Copy plus a schedule collision—not warehouse size. Fix the formula materialization path and/or separate the BDT window from segment refresh.

hiddenDistractors.text: The Snowflake warehouse is still undersized for peak concurrent segment refresh load.
hiddenDistractors.rationale: Warehouse was already enlarged with no relief. Capacity masks the real overlap and formula expansion cost.

hiddenDistractors.text: Zero Copy connector rate limiting is throttling the segment refresh queries.
hiddenDistractors.rationale: No rate-limit evidence. Timeouts track query evaluation cost during BDT overlap.

hiddenDistractors.text: Cross-region network latency between Data Cloud and Snowflake is causing the timeouts.
hiddenDistractors.rationale: No latency incident. Failures are selective to one curated DLO path.
